data.name: Jalees
data.long_meaning: Originated from the Arabic word 'Jalasa' which means 'to descend', 'to go down' or 'to come down'. This name is derived from the root word 'Alaasa' which means 'to be high' or 'to rise'. Therefore, Jalees is the one who descends from a state of highness or the one who comes down from a position of power or authority. This name is also associated with the qualities of gentleness and generosity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jalees is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of humility and service to others. It is a reminder that even those who are in positions of power or authority should be humble and selfless in their actions.

in_arabic.name: جليس
in_arabic.meaning: جليس يعني الجالس الكثير الإجتماعات والمعروف بفطنته ولباقته
in_arabic.long_meaning: جليس هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الشخص الذي يجلس كثيرًا مع الناس و يتميز بالفطنة و اللباقة في الحديث و الإستماع. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات و له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية كونه يدل على الصفات الحميدة مثل التواضع و الألفة و حسن التعامل مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: جلیس

in_urdu.long_meaning: جلیس ایک عربی اصل کا مذکر نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اکثر لوگوں کے ساتھ بیٹھتا ہے اور اپنے حسن گفتگو، فطری ذہانت اور لوگوں کے ساتھ اچھے برتاؤ کی وجہ سے پہچانا جاتا ہے. اس نام کی اہمیت اس لیے بھی ہے کیونکہ یہ اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک قابل تعریف صفت کے طور پر شمار ہوتا ہے جو شخص کے بہتر سماجی تعلقات اور روحانی ترقی کے لیے ضروری ہے.

in_english.name: Jalees
in_english.meaning: Jalees means one who sits in gatherings, known for their wit and pleasant conversation
in_english.long_meaning: Jalees is a masculine name of Arabic origin. It refers to someone who frequently sits in gatherings and is recognized for their wit, pleasant conversation skills, and ability to interact well with others. The name carries significant cultural and spiritual weight in Islamic tradition, symbolizing virtues such as humility, sociability, and good manners. Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic root 'جلس' (j-l-s), which means 'to sit' or 'to gather'. The name Jalees is often associated with positive personality traits like being sociable, friendly, and approachable.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jalees carries significant cultural importance, as it is mentioned in the Holy Quran and hadiths. In Surah Al-Imran, Allah says, "And when the Soul reaches the portion of Knowledge it is said: Take ye the good news (O soul that is in a state of death)! You have responded (to your Lord) correctly, and I will forgive thee (thy sins): (154) This Day we shall let you mount (from your grave) (155) Among honourable Nazareen (i.e. Prophets, Saints, martyrs)... " (Aali Imran, Verses 153-155). Here, Jalees is referred to as 'Nazareen', meaning, 'the one given to the good news of the Paradise', who has responded to Allah's call and been granted admission into Jannah (Heaven). Moreover, in the Hadiths, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) describes Jalees as being among the people from heaven, who will call out to the believers on the Day of Judgement and ask them to hasten towards Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jalees holds profound spiritual significance, as it reflects the humility and submission of a servant to the Will of Allah. The one who descends or comes down from a state of highness to serve and worship Allah shows true devotion and obedience. It is a reminder of the transient nature of worldly positions and earthly possessions and the importance of staying connected to the divine Source. The name Jalees also signifies the gentle and generous nature of Allah, who descends from His Mercy and Bounty upon His creation. Thus, the name Jalees evokes feelings of hope, love, and submission towards Allah, and serves as a constant reminder of His Mercy and Grace.
